headline: FUEL
THE
WORK
lead: Tracking food is this easy: a whole day, logged from two photos.

headline: SNAP IT.
lead: One photo of the plate comes back itemized, and nothing is logged until you say so.
bullets: Eight foods, each on its own line with its own calories.
A confidence read on every row: High or Medium.
Not right? Type the fix: "it was 6 tacos."

headline: SAY IT.
lead: No photo, no problem. Describe the meal in your own words instead.
bullets: "grilled chicken, rice and broccoli" is enough to start.
Works from your words alone. A photo is optional.
Then the same review: check every line, then log it.

headline: FIND IT.
lead: When you already know what it was, the whole database is one field away.
bullets: Search foods and saved meals, brands and calories included.
Barcode, snap and upload, all on the same sheet.
Your foods, recents and frequents, one tap each.

headline: START
TONIGHT'S
LOG.
lead: Tonight's dinner is one photo and a tap away.
